notes.title: Apeiron has Come
notes.content:
[u]Build version 0.9.97[/u]

Update Details:
[list]
[*] Apeiron Game Mode Added
[*] 2 Lithoi selection limitation was removed
[*] You can now re-click a Lithos to close it again (half value Maana cost)
[*] Lithoi Inspector now compares the Lithoi pair information 
[*] Various Bug Fixes
[*] Various Aesthetic and Graphical changes
[/list]
